{{Quote|I know what we did. Fort Klemark. Two hundred dead. Do it, Havoc. You freed my team from the nightmare. Now free what's left of me.|Major Nol Corovani, to [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|the commander]] of [[Havoc Squad]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Nol Corovani''', callsign '''Monarch''', was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Republic Army]] and [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Eclipse Squad]], a [[Republic Special Forces Division]] squad created during the [[Galactic War]]. Along with his squad, he was implanted with experimental [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] cybernetics from a destroyed [[Order of Revan|Revanite]] lab on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].

After [[Havoc Squad]] hunted down and destroyed the rest of his squad, they then confronted Corovani in the jungles of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. Unlike the rest of the squad, who identified Havoc as Revanite traitors, he recognized both [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc's commander]] and General [[Elin Garza]], and told them that he knew what his squad had done at [[Fort Klemark]] on [[Altair 9]], killing two hundred Republic soldiers. He then asked Havoc Squad to "free what's left of me" from the "nightmare" caused by the implants, just as they had his squadmates; Havoc carried out his request.
